November lineup

Our November meetup returns to the Mill19 building with three short talks on training at scale. Doors open at 6pm, talks start at 6:30pm, and pizza is on us.

  • Sam Okafor on scheduling heterogeneous GPU clusters.
  • Alex Rivera on gradient compression in practice.
  • Priya Natarajan on evaluation pipelines for robot learning.

Register on the meetup page; space is limited to 120 people.
